title: JK 2016 Results
text: Congratulations to all our members who competed - under very variable weather conditions - in this year's JK in Yorkshire. Our congratulations in particular go to Ben, Theo and Craig as their Junior relay team was placed third - and won the Bronze medal - in their class. Two other relay teams Bryn, David & Neil R, and Tim, Barney & Matthew were placed 10th and 6th respectively in their highly competitive classes. Our SuffOC results can be found here and the detailed results are on the SI Results page.
